mapper.select: SELECT ID, EVENT_KEY, TPWF_INSTANCE_ID, TASK_ID, STATUS, PAYLOAD, TRIGGERED_BY, CREATION_DATE, WAIT_DATE, TRIGGERED_DATE FROM TS_EVENT WHERE EVENT_KEY = #{eventKey}
mapper.update: UPDATE TS_EVENT SET STATUS = 'TRIGGERED', PAYLOAD = #{payload}, TRIGGERED_BY = #{triggeredBy}, TRIGGERED_DATE = #{triggeredDate} WHERE EVENT_KEY = #{eventKey} AND STATUS IN ('NEW', 'WAITING')
